Class Hyde34LandUseReader

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.Hyde34LandUseReader
public final class Hyde34LandUseReader extends Object

Hyde34LandUseReader

Empirical reader and spherical-area-conservative regridder for HYDE 3.4 anthropogenic land-use archives (*_lu.zip and urban uopp_*.asc from *_pop.zip, 5-arc-minute $4320 \times 2160$ Esri ASCII grids covering $10000\,\text{BCE}$ to $2024\,\text{CE}$).

All extensive land-use area layers ($\text{km}^2$ per 5-arc-minute cell) are transferred onto the standard $2048 \times 1024$ equirectangular grid via ConservativeRasterResampler.resampleExtensive(float[][], int, int, float, int, int) and divided by exact spherical pixel area $A_{\text{px}}(y)$ to yield dimensionless fractional cover fields $\in [0, 1]$, guaranteeing strict global area conservation across latitudes.

Scientific Applications

  • Anthropogenic Ecological Footprint Tensor (Anthromes): Ellis & Ramankutty (2008) / Sanderson et al. (2002) land-transformation intensity replacing synthetic Gaussian blobs.
  • Bioclimatic Canopy Conversion: Historical deforestation (forest/jungle clearance into cultivated plains) and alluvial oasis irrigation (Pongratz et al. 2008; Kaplan et al. 2009).

    • clearCache

    • loadForYear

      public static Hyde34LandUseReader.LandUseFields loadForYear(long year)
      Loads and conservatively downsamples HYDE 3.4 land-use fractional fields for the given year. Returns null for deep pre-agricultural epochs (year < -10000, where anthropogenic agriculture is identically $0.0\%$ per AGENTS.md §8.2) or if local archives are absent.
      Parameters:
      year - historical simulation year
      Returns:
      downsampled Hyde34LandUseReader.LandUseFields, or null if pre-Holocene or unavailable

    • computeAnthropogenicStrainIndex

      public static double computeAnthropogenicStrainIndex(double cropFrac, double irriFrac, double pastFrac, double rangeFrac, double urbanFrac)
      Computes a continuous anthropogenic ecological transformation intensity $\in [0, 1]$ calibrated to Ellis & Ramankutty (2008) Anthromes and Sanderson et al. (2002) Human Footprint biome weights: $$S_{\text{eco}} = \text{clamp}\!\big(1.0\,f_{\text{urb}} + 0.85\,f_{\text{crop}} + 0.15\,f_{\text{irri}} + 0.50\,f_{\text{past}} + 0.20\,f_{\text{range}},\; 0,\; 1\big)$$
      Parameters:
      cropFrac - cropland fractional area $[0, 1]$
      irriFrac - irrigated cropland fractional area $[0, 1]$
      pastFrac - intensive pasture fractional area $[0, 1]$
      rangeFrac - extensive rangeland fractional area $[0, 1]$
      urbanFrac - built-up urban fractional area $[0, 1]$
      Returns:
      continuous ecological strain index in $[0.0, 1.0]$

    • modulateBiomeWithLandUse

      public static int modulateBiomeWithLandUse(int naturalBiomeRgb, int x, int y, Hyde34LandUseReader.LandUseFields fields)
      Modulates a natural Holdridge/Whittaker biome RGB color code using empirical HYDE 3.4 agricultural land-cover transformation (deforestation & alluvial irrigation). Never alters oceanic basins, polar glaciers, alpine snow, mountains, or tundra.
      Parameters:
      naturalBiomeRgb - 24-bit RGB biome code from WorldClimEmpiricalRasterLoader
      x - pixel X coordinate in $[0, \text{ETHER\_WIDTH}-1]$
      y - pixel Y coordinate in $[0, \text{ETHER\_HEIGHT}-1]$
      fields - loaded Hyde34LandUseReader.LandUseFields for the epoch (may be null)
      Returns:
      anthropogenically modulated 24-bit RGB biome code
